non_screens.why: Redirect stub ("Đang mở tài chính trong Pema Clinic…" and a link "Mở Clinic") that location.replace()s to clinic-web/?screen=finance (WG1) before it is drawn. The app never links to it.
non_screens.proof: grep -rn "finance/'\|finance/\"" prototype/shared prototype/finance/finance.js prototype/clinic-web prototype/patient-mobile  → only finance-bridge.js#status (href="../finance/", a link inside WA1 that WA8 shows) points at it; following that link lands on WG1.

non_screens.why: Dead code: no button opens it. clinic.js#bind routes the value to PemaOpsUI.openBooking (WB7) before modalHtml is reached.
non_screens.proof: cat prototype/shared/*.js | grep -oE 'data-modal=[^ >]{1,25}' | sort -u  → care, edit, message, note, patient, plan-edit; no data-modal="appointment" is ever rendered.

non_screens.what: clinic.js#modalHtml fallback "Chưa có form trong demo"
non_screens.why: Dead code: every data-modal value rendered by the UI has a form (see the search of the previous entry).
non_screens.proof: same search: the six rendered values are all handled by modalHtml before its fallback.

non_screens.why: A prescription is only created by makePrescription (indication always set) and the UI offers no way to blank it.
non_screens.proof: grep -n "indication" prototype/shared/*.js  → only two assignments, both non-empty (care-finance.js:50 and :61); "Tạo đơn nháp" opens the catalog order dialog (WF3), not a prescription.

non_screens.what: crm-ui.js#summary fallbacks "Chưa có ngày dự kiến" and "Chưa có nguồn"
non_screens.why: Every one of the 46 demo patients (and a new one) has an expected return date and a source; the form "Ngày dự kiến quay lại" refuses an empty date or source.
non_screens.proof: live check on 4173: PemaCRM.profile() over all 46 patients returns expectedNextVisitAt and a known expectedVisitSource for each; grep -n "Nhập ngày hợp lệ, lý do và nguồn khuyến nghị" prototype/shared/crm-automation.js (WC34 shows the refusal).

non_screens.why: Only fires for an order that is neither draft nor approved; the UI has no way to delete or void an order.

non_screens.what: crm-automation.js#reception "Lịch không thể chuyển trạng thái."
non_screens.why: Only fires when the appointment of a reception row changed in another window before the click; the list re-renders on the storage event, so the stale row is gone before it can be clicked (the same race with an open dialog is WB22).
non_screens.proof: live check on 4173 (two tabs): after the second tab marks P001 "Vắng", the first tab's row already shows "Mở 360" instead of "Check-in". Call sites: grep -n "C.reception(" prototype/shared/crm-ui.js → only the three buttons arrive/start/missed.
covers: text:Lịch không thể chuyển trạng thái

non_screens.what: staff-context.js#assert "… không có tác vụ này"
non_screens.why: Guard behind buttons the UI never draws for that role: apply() removes them, pages are gated by allowed(), and switching the account closes any open dialog.
non_screens.proof: grep -n "assert(" prototype/shared/*.js  → clinical (crm-automation, order-data, order-review), crm, booking, billing, config; each is reachable only from controls removed by staff-context.js#apply for the roles that lack the capability (see WC22–WC27, WF18).

non_screens.what: patient.js#action confirm-appointment toast "Chưa có lịch hẹn để xác nhận"
non_screens.why: The button is rendered disabled when the patient has no appointment, so the click never happens (WI22).
covers: text:Chưa có lịch hẹn để xác nhận

non_screens.why: The doctor's tab bar has only Tổng quan and Tiền thủ thuật, and the tab variable changes only through those buttons.
